previous_statement: Conditionally on the scalar facts just displayed (equivalently, for any witnesses and W satisfying those displayed facts), let A be a finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra with 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN and set t=epsilon. Since t <= W.r_reset <= e_0 and epsilon <= t, lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion furnishes the literal scalar map u_0:C->A, u_0(lambda)=lambda I_A. The initial-call clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, applied at this same t and target ambient defect epsilon <= t, states that this same literal u_0 is an extended D_*t-inclusion and ||u_0(I_C)-I_A|| <= D_*t. Recording its global-scalar tag, source C, target A, scale t, target defect epsilon, literal level-one map, and fixed amplifications makes it the explicit raw call required by def-maincb-raw-call; no replacement map is introduced.
new_statement: Let the universal witnesses and W obey D_* = max{1,D_0,D_1,D_2,D_3}, D_* >= 1, W.r_reset <= e_0, and, whenever 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN, epsilon <= W.r_reset, exactly as supplied by lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, lem-maincb-witness-arithmetic, and lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger. For a finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra A with 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN, set t=epsilon. Then epsilon <= t <= e_0, so lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion furnishes the literal scalar map u_0:C->A, u_0(lambda)=lambda I_A. Because 0 <= t <= W.r_reset and the target ambient defect epsilon is at most t, the initial-call clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger states that this same literal u_0 is an extended D_*t-inclusion and ||u_0(I_C)-I_A|| <= D_*t. Recording its global-scalar tag, source C, target A, scale t, target defect epsilon, literal level-one map, and fixed amplifications makes it the explicit raw call required by def-maincb-raw-call; no replacement map is introduced.
